item.description:
Batteries v3.1.0

  • The battery menu now shows when you're on a slow charger.
  • New Energy Mode section with a Low Power Mode toggle.
  • See which apps are using significant energy.
  • Refreshed battery icons for your iPhone, iPad, AirPods and other accessories, in the menu and in the widget.
  • Support for the latest iPhones, iPads, AirPods (including AirPods Pro 3) and Beats.
  • Better detection of Logitech and other third-party mice and keyboards.
